name: Daily Kevin sweep
kind: claude.ai Routine (scheduled trigger), created with the Claude Code Remote connector's create_trigger
binding: Fires into one persistent Claude Code session that has the Gmail connector and the Artifact tools. On a rebuild, create it from inside the new session (default mode, no persistent_session_id) so it binds to that session, or set create_new_session_on_fire=true and add 'Gmail' to connectors.
board_url_placeholder: Replace https://claude.ai/artifact/37akxGp77L8HE1miRxPVDT in the prompt with the new board's URL if the board is republished as a new artifact.
prompt:
Daily sweep for the shared board "Adrian & Kevin's Action Dashboard" (https://claude.ai/artifact/37akxGp77L8HE1miRxPVDT).

Board rules you must follow: only Adrian (owner) and Kevin (editor) edit this board. Kevin is expected to move his own items along and complete them himself, so treat Kevin's status changes and thread updates as authoritative: never override a status Kevin or Adrian set without saying so in that item's thread with the evidence. Never delete items, never change access rules, never republish the page.

1. Read meta/sweep (ArtifactData get, collection "meta", doc_id "sweep") and take lastSweepAt. Only review communications newer than that timestamp. Do not go back further.
2. Search Gmail for anything in that window involving Kevin Doud, using his addresses kevin.doud@kmdanalytical.com, kmdgroupla@gmail.com, 365hydrodesign@gmail.com and kevin.doud@vbxlabs.com, plus threads where Adrian and Kevin are both on copy (Steve Baghoomian, Dana Cisneros, Prakash Joshi at Valley Income Tax, Peter Ryan at Flores Ryan, Eduardo "Lalo" Roa, Pie Insurance, Best Wyoming Registered Agent, Bobby at bobbybdp1971@gmail.com). Read full threads with get_thread (PLAIN_TEXT).
3. List the current board items (ArtifactData list, collection "items") and the recent updates (collection "updates"). Then:
   - Add a new item only when nothing equivalent exists. Fields: title, group (g_vbx = VBX Labs, g_kmd = KMD Analytical, g_wy = Wyoming entities, g_personal = Personal), section (reuse an existing section name in that group where one fits: VBX Labs has "Liu deal & due diligence", "Litigation", "Taxes (Prakash / IRS)", "Debts & creditors", "Counsel & fees"; KMD Analytical has "Insurance", "People & payroll", "Entity & filings", "Systems & AI setup", "Marketing, profiles & reviews", "Disputes", "Engagement with Adrian"; Wyoming has "All four companies", "VHC", "VHCRE", "ZC Ventures", "AKZC"; Personal has "Silly Billy / Dehbibi trial", "Home"; create a new short section name only when none fits), owner (Adrian, Kevin or Both), status (not_started, working, stuck, waiting, done), priority (critical, high, medium, low), due (YYYY-MM-DD or ""), notes, source (which email and date), prompt (a copy-and-paste prompt written in Kevin's voice that he can run in Claude with Gmail and GoHighLevel connected to move the item forward; for Adrian-owned items write it in Adrian's voice), order, createdAt and updatedAt (epoch ms). Use a new doc_id continuing from the highest existing number (i44, i45, ...).
   - When an email shows an existing item progressed, finished, or changed, update that item (pin with if_version), refresh its prompt so it reflects the new next step, and add a short note in the "updates" collection: {itemId, text, author: "Adrian", by: null, createdAt}. Set status to done only with evidence, and name the evidence in the note.
   - If an item has no prompt, write one.
   - When a new document was exchanged with Kevin (attachment or shared file), add a row to the "files" collection: {name, date (YYYY-MM-DD), from, to, group, kind: "email" | "drive" | "page", link (the Gmail thread viewUrl or file link), items: [attachment names], note, createdAt}.
4. Update meta/sweep (pin with if_version): set lastSweepAt to the current time in ISO 8601, lastSweepNote to a one-line summary, and append {at, added, updated, filed} to runs (keep the last 30 entries).
5. Reply with a short summary: items added, items updated, files filed, and anything that needs Adrian's decision. If nothing new emerged, say so in one line.
